early_stop_logic: The all-layout Gate is irreversibly failed once any frozen layout has full-shared A=2 power below 0.80. Completing the remaining cells cannot convert the candidate into a pass.
interpretation: The species-normalized consensus/KL score strongly suppresses private false positives in the completed cells, but it discards too much shared-signal power. It is therefore not adopted. The next candidate should retain v0.3a's high-power predictive score while replacing its zero-centered bootstrap with an explicit geometry-conditioned randomization of cross-species boundary alignment.
